full_prompt_en: A square cinematic city image places a large ornate stone building across the lower left and center beneath an immense dark storm sky. The building rises several stories, with rows of tall windows, carved surrounds, a steep roof and small dormers. Its left wing fades into deep shadow, while the projecting corner and right facade catch a warm amber glow. Several windows shine more brightly, making the illuminated stone appear to stand out from the murky surroundings. A smaller block of similarly aged buildings recedes down the street on the right. The street at the base is broad and nearly empty, with only tiny dark shapes near the entrances. Overhead, charcoal and slate clouds twist into a heavy layered canopy. A dim opening near the upper left releases a cold patch of light, while a brighter yellow-orange gap glows low on the right. The building occupies less than half the height of the frame, so the weather feels far larger than the built scene. Detailed window rhythm and cornices provide crisp vertical and horizontal structure beneath the more fluid cloud shapes. The illumination is sharply selective: exposed parts of the facade glow, but roof slopes, left wall and street remain almost black. Fine haze and deep tonal falloff reduce detail away from the lit corner. The palette is limited to blue-gray, charcoal, brown stone and small bands of orange-gold. The composition holds the architecture as a grounded, still anchor while the sky gathers turbulent movement above it. The whole view is dramatic and quiet, suggesting a brief, unstable interval of light before rain.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形电影感城市图像把大型华丽石楼放在下方左侧及中央，上方压着巨大的深色暴风天空。楼房有多层高，成排高窗、雕饰窗框、陡屋顶和小阁楼窗可见。左翼逐渐陷入深影，凸出的角楼与右立面则接住暖琥珀光。几扇窗更明亮，让受光石材从浑浊环境中跳出来。右边一组同样古旧、较矮的建筑沿街退远。底部街道宽阔且几乎无人，门口附近只有极小深色形状。头顶炭黑与石板灰云扭成厚重层叠的顶篷。左上附近的暗缺口放出一点冷光，右下较亮的缺口泛黄橙色。建筑占画幅高度不到一半，天气因而显得远比城市巨大。细致的窗列和檐口在流动云形下提供清楚的竖横结构。照明极有选择性：露出的立面部分发亮，屋顶坡面、左墙和街道则几乎全黑。细雾与迅速变暗的明度使受光角楼以外的细节减少。调色限制在蓝灰、炭黑、褐石和少量橙金色带。构图让建筑成为落地静止的锚点，天空则在上方聚起汹涌运动。整幅景象戏剧化而安静，像雨前一段短暂不稳定的光。
style_prompt_en: The image has a dark cinematic photographic finish with a wide tonal range concentrated in a few selectively illuminated passages. Charcoal and blue-gray dominate broad upper and side areas, interrupted by small amber-gold breaks. Crisp repeated linear details anchor the lower field, while soft turbulent masses sweep across the upper field. Light grazes exposed planes and windows, leaving adjacent surfaces to fall rapidly into shadow. Edges range from sharply defined in the lit region to almost unreadable in dark haze. A low visual horizon grants most of the frame to atmosphere, making small grounded forms feel vulnerable beneath the larger movement. Fine environmental texture survives in the highlights, but broad shadow areas remain simple. The spatial mood is deep yet compressed by weather, with distant layers partially obscured. The overall effect is somber and suspenseful, built from restrained warm light, vast cool darkness and a strong contrast between stable geometry and shifting air.
style_prompt_zh: 图像具有暗调电影摄影质感，宽明暗范围集中在少数选择性受光段落。炭黑和蓝灰主导上方与侧边大片区域，少量琥珀金色缺口打断它们。清楚且重复的线性细节压住下方色域，柔软汹涌的团块横扫上方。光擦过暴露平面和小亮面，相邻表面很快沉入阴影。边缘从受光区的鲜明界线，到暗雾中几乎不可辨的形状。低位视觉地平线把大部分画幅让给空气，使下方小形体在更大的运动之下显得脆弱。亮处保留细环境肌理，宽阔暗区则保持简洁。空间情绪深远，却被天气压缩，远方层次部分遮蔽。整体效果阴郁而悬疑，由克制暖光、大片冷暗和稳定几何与流动空气的强烈对照构成。
theme_en: An ornate old city building glows on one side beneath a heavy charcoal storm sky
theme_zh: 一座华丽的旧城楼宇在浓重炭色暴风云下，一侧泛起暖光
name: Alexandre Deschaumes
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
